statusLine.command: input=$(cat); j() { echo "$input" | jq -r "$1"; }; t() { date -d "@$1" "+$2" 2>/dev/null || date -r "$1" "+$2"; }; out=$(j '.model.display_name'); e=$(j '.effort.level // empty'); [ -n "$e" ] && out="$out ($e)"; u=$(j '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); r=$(j '.rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at // empty'); if [ -n "$u" ]; then out="$out | session $(printf '%.0f' "$u")%"; [ -n "$r" ] && out="$out, resets $(t "$r" '%H:%M')"; fi; u=$(j '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); r=$(j '.rate_limits.seven_day.resets_at // empty'); if [ -n "$u" ]; then out="$out | week $(printf '%.0f' "$u")%"; [ -n "$r" ] && out="$out, resets $(t "$r" '%a %d %b %H:%M')"; fi; printf '%s' "$out"
